newsitem.title: UK: Light sugar freight fixtures and new orders.
newsitem.headline: Light sugar freight fixtures and new orders.

text.p: Sugar freight market business was slower on Wednesday as the market quietened ahead of the Easter holiday period.
Fixtures - Pacol rumoured to have booked 20,000 bulk from Cadiz to Black Sea for prompt dates and 14,000 bulk from Cuba to Black Sea for end March early April.
Dreyfus wre rumoured to have fixed 25,000 bulk sugar from Cuba to Black Sea/Baltic end March/early April.
New orders - Dreyfus 18,000 bulk from West Coast Central America to Savannah for mid April and C.Czarnikow 16,800 bulk Laemchabang or Sriracha to Indonesia mid-April.
Benham 14,000/20,000 bulk from Punta Morales to Toronto mid-April.
Cargill 3,000/5,000 bulk from Puerto Quetzal to Haiti prompt.
